So the function returns the 1-indexed position of the rightmost set bit (counting from the right, starting at 1).

I can use a recursive spec fun. Let me define:

spec fun rsbp(n: int): int

Let me define a spec fun for integer division by 2:

```
spec fun div2(n: int): int
  decreases n
= if n <= 0 then 0 else if n == 1 then 0 else 1 + div2(n - 2)
```

This computes floor(n/2) for n >= 0.

Then I can define:
```
spec fun rsbp(n: int): int
  decreases n
= if n <= 0 then 0 else if n - 2 * div2(n) == 1 then 1 else 1 + rsbp(div2(n))
```
